statement: Fourteen topological relative-position types of three circles are listed and their contact-circle counts and contact types tabulated.

answer.text: Fourteen topological relative-position types of three circles are listed and their contact-circle counts and contact types tabulated.

source.location: Sections 4–5, original pp.137–141; Table I, p.141; Sections 6 ff for boundary cases
source.version: Original pp.135–147, Cambridge digitized journal PDF (online 20 January 2009); publisher volume year 1895, often cited 1896.

scope: Three real input circles; generic relative-position types, with special tangencies handled separately.
notes: The fourteen incidence types are not asserted to be fourteen connected real discriminant-complement chambers. Table I is inspected alongside its explanatory prose; historical special self-contact conventions must be retained.
